profile.summary:
Currently: Independent mobile application developer with a strong focus on mobile apps and the iOS platform. Branching into Open Source Hardware with a DIY e-book reader, the Open Book.

Previously: Software engineer at Podop, Inc. working on interactive storytelling.

Before that: Senior Software Engineer for Accenture; and Mobile Application Developer for American Express Publishing. 

Before that: MA in journalism at the University of Texas at Austin, doing multimedia reporting on the experience of LGBT people coming out to family members, and the resulting shift in family relationships.

positions.title: Independent mobile app developer
positions.description: Founded Panchromatic, LLC; developed, deployed and marketed two iPhone apps (TweetSheet, Apr 2010; SmokeBreak, Oct 2010), one Android app (SmokeBreak for Android, 2011) one iPad app (Dictapad, 2011) and one Apple Watch app (Better Day, 2015).

positions.title: Assistant and printer
positions.description: Responsible for toning raw images and preparing inkjet prints for exhibition in China, Colombia, El Salvador and the US. Assisted at photo workshops. Handled archive materials; scanned negatives; designed catalogs of prints and promotional materials.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: Selected to take part in the summer-long initiative; reported on race and politics in California; developed and deployed a custom Flash video interface for the News21 Maryland site.
